product_one_liner.value: Sauce Labs provides a cloud-based, full-lifecycle test automation and release-assurance platform for software development and QA teams to test web and mobile apps across browsers and real or virtual devices.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes its platform as supporting testing, integration, error monitoring, and release of web and mobile apps.

pricing_page.notes: The public page lists plans and prices as well as enterprise options.

named_customers.notes: All three names appear in Sauce Labs' case-study index.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists the company size as 201–500 employees.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn identifies San Francisco, California, as the headquarters.

founded_year.notes: LinkedIn lists Sauce Labs as founded in 2008.

eng_blog.notes: The index is a general company blog of product, testing guidance, and marketing content, not a distinct engineering blog. Technical architecture posts are present, but the reviewed material does not establish at least two posts about how Sauce Labs builds its product authored by engineers.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation site has multiple product, API, CLI, framework, and setup articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current careers listings include an AI Architect role.

model_provider.notes: Reviewed the AURA model-choice announcement and available product documentation/search results. Sauce Labs describes customer choice of open-source, open-weight, or proprietary LLMs but does not publicly identify a specific provider or model used by the product.

compliance_certs.notes: The cited Sauce Labs trust-center article names SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001, and GDPR compliance. ISO 27701 is not included because it is outside the list requested.

last_funding.notes: Sauce Labs announced a $50 million growth investment from Riverwood Capital on March 26, 2019; this is the latest round located in the reviewed funding history.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest located funding announcement is dated March 2019, before the 18-month window beginning 2025-05-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Current careers listings show Account Executive and Inside Sales Representative openings.

launched_6mo.notes: Sauce Labs announced the launch of its AURA platform on July 22, 2026, inside the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Sauce Labs announced Steven Fitz as Chief Revenue Officer and Arun Lal as SVP of Global Marketing on April 16, 2026, inside the 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The Sauce Labs VP, Sales job posting refers to CRM inspection and pipeline work in Salesforce.
